message.content:
**UNO – Official Rules (as published by Mattel)** | Section | What you need to know | |---------|-----------------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score at least 500 points over several rounds. Points come from opponents’ remaining cards when someone goes “Out.” | | **Deck** | Standard UNO deck has 108 cards:
• Four colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 each
• Each color contains one 0 and two copies of numbers 1–9.
• Eight action cards per color:
  • 2×+2
  • 2×Skip
  • 2×Reverse

• Two Wilds & two Wild‑Draw‑Four per deck. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle all cards together.
• Deal seven cards face down to each player.
• Place the rest as a draw pile facedown.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile onto the discard pile to start the *play* area. If it’s an action or wild card, treat it like any other card until a normal numbered card appears. | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise unless a Reverse changes direction. A Skip simply passes the turn to the next player. | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may place one card on the discard pile if it matches either the *color*, the *number/symbol*, or the *wildness* of the current top card. Example: Red 5 → you could play another red card or any 5 regardless of color. | | **Special Cards** | - **+2**: Next player draws two cards then loses their turn.
- **Skip**: Next player immediately misses their turn.
- **Reverse**: Changes play direction (acts like Skip with only one opponent).
- **Wild**: You choose the new active color.
- **Wild +4**: Same as Wild but forces the next player to draw four cards—only playable if you have no matching colored card. | | **Drawing** | If you cannot legally play a card, you must draw one card from the draw pile. If this drawn card is playable, you may use it right away; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Going Out (“UNO”)** | When you’re left with exactly one card after playing, shout “UNO!” before anyone else sees your hand. Failure to do so results in drawing two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | First person who discards all his/her cards wins the round. Opponents tally up point values of the cards still in their hands:
• Numbered cards = face value.
• Action cards (+2/Skip/Reverse) = 20 pts.
• Wild/Wild +4 = 50 pts.
The winner adds those points to their total score. | | **Game End** | Play continues through successive rounds until somebody reaches ≥ 500 points. That player is declared overall champion. | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Keep track of the last played card** – helps decide whether you can skip or reverse later. 2. **Use Wild +4 strategically** – save it for moments where you really want to force a big draw. 3. **Watch others' “UNO” calls** – they give clues about what cards remain in opponents’ hands. 4. **Plan ahead** – try to keep low‑value cards early so you win more quickly. Enjoy!
